name: Anh Draws
tagline: Live wedding painting and live guest portraits. Based in Saigon, traveling everywhere.
bio: I paint weddings live: a moment from your day, painted on canvas while your guests watch. My team of artists also draws live portraits of your guests. 2027 is my fourth year of Anh Draws, and I'm close to my 100th event. Thank you to every couple and partner who has trusted us with their day.
terms: Book about 6 months ahead. 2027 dates through March are almost full.

experiences.name: Live wedding painting
experiences.desc: I paint a moment from your wedding live, on canvas, while your guests watch it come together. You keep the painting.
includes: A painting of a moment you choose, painted live
Travel anywhere, quoted with your date
experiences.setup: A spot near the action with room for an easel.

experiences.name: Live guest portraits
experiences.desc: Our artists draw your guests during the celebration, and each one takes their portrait home. For bigger weddings and events, we bring more artists.
includes: A team of artists for larger events
Paper and sleeves for every portrait
